NEWSROOM BRIEF

US crude stocks kept falling, but the latest draw slowed

A smaller US crude cushion, a slower draw: EIA's October 21 figures separate the stock level from the pace of decline.

What to watch: EIA listed October 28 as the next release date.

Full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-2073ac9bca91e29f
